identification: Three rectangular 1 imperial gallon motor oil tins, Australian market, c1950s-60s: (1) Wakefield Castrol Motor Oil (green/cream, red script Castrol 'REGD', grade panel with old handwriting), no Royal warrant panel visible on the front; (2) later green Castrol Motor Oil tin with circle-and-flag logo (1960s), blank grade panel; (3) taller cream/red Redex tin, 'Add to all oils & petrol / Red-eX / Test & Tune / Extreme Pressure oil activator & carbon repellent', 'Peak Performance, Preventive Maintenance, Economy of Fuel & Wear', Australian distributor text at base (not legible). All with caps; overall fair to good, light scratches, paint loss on edges, some soiling; Redex top seam a bit rusty.
